description: Infers Internet path congestion from Round-Trip Time series by detecting change points and classifying each period with a latency jump and a jitter test.
rules: Install with `pip install jitterbug-inference`. The PyPI name `jitterbug` is an unrelated project; import `jitterbug` and run the `jitterbug` command.
CSV rows need `epoch` in Unix seconds and an RTT in milliseconds (`values`, or `rtt_value`, `rtt`, or `latency`). RTT must be greater than 0 and at most 10000 ms.
The default pipeline is sequential: ruptures change points and jitter dispersion. Reproduce the paper with `--algorithm bcp --method ks_test` after installing the `bcp` extra.
Online mode is `jitterbug stream` and `jitterbug replay`. Backend `bocpd` (the default) needs the `bcp` extra; `window` reruns the offline pipeline on a trailing window.
`jitterbug visualize` needs the `visualization` extra and uses matplotlib. Non-sequential analysis is `--mode clustering` and needs the `clustering` extra.
